name: Angstrom
mechanic: Runs its own auction to internalize MEV and hand the value back to traders and LPs.
plain: Angstrom takes control of transaction ordering and runs an application-specific auction, so the value that would otherwise be extracted through sandwiching and arbitrage is captured and redirected back to users.
rules: Swaps are ordered by an application-specific auction, not first-come.
Captured MEV is redirected back to traders and liquidity providers.
